facts.fact: The Communications Authority says its Universal Service Fund financed voice and data infrastructure in 76 sub-locations across 15 counties between 2015 and 2021, giving access to over 500,000 people in unserved areas.

The Communications Authority's USF Strategy 2023-2027 says the Authority will give direct financial support to roll out 2,500 km of fibre in unserved and underserved areas, with a Ksh 40.037 billion plan for the period.
